question: Coulomb per second is equivalent to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ampere**__.

__
 
• **Coulomb** per second is equivalent to **ampere**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **One coulomb is the charge flowing through a wire in 1 second if the current is 1 Ampere**. A coulomb is a unit of electric charge.
 
• A coulomb is a name given in the memory of **French physicist Charles Augustin de Coulomb**.
 
• **Coulomb force **and **gravitational force **follow the same inverse** square law.**
 
• But gravitational force has **only one sign** (always attractive), while Coulomb force can be of **both signs **(attractive and repulsive), allowing the possibility of cancellation of **electric force.**
